test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: V, W, X, Y, Z, A and B are seven boxes kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. A is kept immediately above W. Only four boxes are kept between B and W. Only one box is kept between V and X. X is kept immediately above A. B is kept at the topmost position. How many boxes are kept between Z and Y?
solution:
Given:

Seven boxes: V, W, X, Y, Z, A, and B are kept one over the other.

But not necessarily in the same order as given.

Boxes are placed as follows,

 
• A is kept above W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a30e28a24faddc0b49c1f61f08069c614299afb1c272058f83b2a897557a1fce.png] 

 
• Four boxes are kept between B and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/714791cf74f1550c59bc52c6b9d51a166d3a2e89807d964d23e90498ebae477e.png] 

 
• One box is between V and X.
 
• X is kept above A.
 
• B is kept at topmost position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7be094e1278d7dbef0489e1307806fe555c1f30232d38b4b0877b26e3206d6a7.png] 

 
• Final position of the boxes is shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c8beac6a8a62e0827aea3eb16dc3b48e4e45e0e6b111d6d50c41077893ac43d.png] 

Thus, there are **three** boxes kept between Z and Y.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3)**.
